get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of translations for a given Type(String/Schema), with optional locale, module, search and filtering

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The translation type (e.g., String, Schema). Required.

parameters.name: locales
parameters.description: The locales identifier (e.g., "en-US") to filter translations. Optional.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: The module name to filter translations. Optional.

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The text to search for in translation keys. Optional.

parameters.name: includeTotalCount
parameters.description: Indicates whether to include the total count of records in the response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page. Defaults to the maximum limit which is 100.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results. Optional. Defaults to ModifiedDate.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: The direction in which to sort the results (Ascending or Descending). Optional. Defaults to Descending.

delete.summary: Bulk delete translations for a specific locale

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale for which translations are to be deleted (e.g., "en-US").

requestBody.description: A list of translation delete requests containing key, module, type, protection status, and delete-for-all-locales flag.

post.summary: Bulk create translations for a specific locale

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale for which translations are to be created (e.g., "en-US").

requestBody.description: A list of translation requests containing key, module, value, and type information.

put.summary: Bulk update translations for a specific locale

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale for which translations are to be updated (e.g., "en-US").

requestBody.description: A list of translation update requests containing key, module, value, type, protection status, and locales.

post.summary: Export translations for the specified locale and modules as a CSV file

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale identifier (e.g., "en-US") for which translations are to be exported.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The Conga.Platform.Translation.Enums.TranslationType to filter the translations to export. Optional.

requestBody.description: An array of module names to include in the export.

post.summary: Import translations from a file for the specified locale using the v2 import logic

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale identifier (e.g., "en-US") for which translations are to be imported.

translations.description: The file containing translation data to be imported.

get.summary: Retrieve all defined translation modules for the specified translation type

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The Conga.Platform.Translation.Enums.TranslationType for which to retrieve modules.

get.summary: Get the current Organization Locales configuration

put.summary: Configure locales in Organization Locales configuration

requestBody.description: A list of locale codes to set for the organization.

get.summary: Get the current Organization Locales Change Tracking Info

parameters.name: trackingId
parameters.description: TrackingId returned against Org Locale change.

post.summary: Automatically translate the schema of an object based on the provided metadata and target locale(s)
post.description:
This endpoint processes the given object metadata and generates translations for all translatable elements
such as display names, descriptions, and field labels. The operation is executed asynchronously.

parameters.name: targetLocales
parameters.description: Optional list of target locale(s) for translation. If not provided, default locales will be used.

requestBody.description:
The metadata of the object to be translated, including its name, display name, 
description, fields, and other properties that will be translated.

Note: The object metadata must be provided in English only. This ensures accurate translationsto the target locale(s).

schema.description:
Represents a response for auto-translation.
This class is a dictionary where the key is a string representing a schema/text name,
and the value is another dictionary with keys as field names and values as their translated strings.

500.description: Internal server error during translation processing

post.summary: Automatically translate a set of text key-value pairs into the specified target locales
post.description: This endpoint processes the given text data and generates translations for target locales.

parameters.name: targetLocales
parameters.description: Optional list of target locale(s) for translation. If not provided, default locales will be used.

requestBody.description:
A dictionary containing the keys/values. Corresponding values to be translated and Keys will be retained as is.

Note: The text value must be provided in English only. This ensures accurate translationsto the target locale(s).

schema.description:
Represents a response for auto-translation.
This class is a dictionary where the key is a string representing a schema/text name,
and the value is another dictionary with keys as field names and values as their translated strings.

500.description: Internal server error during translation processing
